name: dezzign
description: Redesign a client's existing website the ZekerZichtbaar way: crawl the old site, build the full sitemap, pick fitting Osmo and Made With GSAP resources and produce every page as a Claude Design canvas, then push it to Figma. Encodes the recurring 'stramien' - page skeleton, section patterns and style directions - distilled from the sites we build, plus a variant library of outside patterns swept from Mobbin so runs do not converge on one layout.
